title: Qantas Finally Books New York, United Bets Big on Skinny Jets, and Virgin Australia's Crew Are Done Being Nice
summary: Qantas locks in its second Project Sunrise route and it's a doozy — Sydney to JFK, nonstop, starting 2028. Plus, United loads up an A321XLR with lie-flat seats for a brutal transatlantic route Air Canada already tried and failed, Virgin Australia's cabin crew are calling in sick in droves, and stranded CrowdStrike passengers take their fight to the Supreme Court.
